expenses.awardHint: You decide the value. The points are added to the buyer's wallet at once.

wallets.empty: No wallets yet. A buyer's wallet is created the first time they open it.

purchases.refundPrompt: Refund {points} points to {name}? Add a note (optional):

pointsSetup.exhibitionsHint: A buyer gets these points once, when they check in by QR code or you mark them as attended. 0 = no reward. If you add regions below, they are used first and this number is only the fallback.
pointsSetup.toursHint: Buyers can pay for a tour with points when it has a price here. 0 = cannot be bought with points.
pointsSetup.regionsHint: Some exhibitions pay different points depending on where the buyer comes from. Each region lists words (cities, provinces, in English or Chinese) that are looked for in the buyer's departure city. Regions are checked from the top; the first match wins. The last row catches everyone else.
pointsSetup.regionsNone: No regions: everyone gets the single number above.

settings.transferDailyMax: Most points one buyer can send per day
settings.limitsHint: Amounts are whole points (1 point = 1 RMB). The per-transfer limit can't be higher than the daily limit.
settings.transfersEnabled: Buyers can send points to each other
settings.topupHint: Shown on the buyer's Top up page. Buyers pay you outside the site, then upload proof.

adminBuyerForm.title: Buyer form settings
adminBuyerForm.subtitle: Choose which documents buyers upload and which extra questions they answer. Changes show everywhere straight away: the buyer's pages, the admin table, filters, and the Excel and ZIP downloads.
adminBuyerForm.howItWorks: The built-in documents can be renamed, reordered, hidden or made optional. Documents and questions you add are stored separately. Hiding something keeps what buyers already gave; it just stops being shown and exported.
adminBuyerForm.documentsHint: Files a buyer uploads (images or PDF). Order here is the order everywhere.
adminBuyerForm.fieldsHint: Additional information a buyer fills in on their profile, shown after the standard company details.
adminBuyerForm.nameHint: English is required. If Russian or Chinese is left empty, the English name is shown.
adminBuyerForm.requiredHint: A buyer counts as Verified only when every required document is uploaded and checked. Optional documents are shown but do not hold that back.
adminBuyerForm.optionsHint: One choice per line. Write the same number of lines in each language, in the same order; leave Russian or Chinese empty to show English.
adminBuyerForm.optionsChangeNote: Changing the wording of a choice does not change what buyers already chose; their old answer stays as it was saved.
adminBuyerForm.deleteBlocked: Buyers have already filled this in, so it can only be hidden.
adminBuyerForm.loadFailed: Could not load the settings. Please refresh the page.
adminBuyerForm.notReady: The database update for this page has not been applied yet. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.invalid_input: Some details are missing or not valid. A name is needed, and a list needs at least two different choices.
errors.options_mismatch: Russian and Chinese choices must have the same number of lines as English (or be left empty).
errors.limit: You have reached the limit of items you can add.
errors.in_use: Buyers have already filled this in, so it cannot be deleted. Hide it instead.
errors.builtin: Built-in items cannot be deleted. Hide them instead.
errors.not_found: That item no longer exists. Please refresh the page.
errors.not_ready: The database update for this page has not been applied yet. Try again in a few minutes.

storage.title: Photo storage
storage.intro: Buyer photos are shrunk automatically when they are uploaded. This button shrinks the big photos that were uploaded earlier, so the website and the Excel and ZIP downloads stay fast. Review statuses are not changed and PDF files are left as they are.

storage.large: {files} large photos ({size} MB) can be shrunk.
storage.noneLarge: No large photos: nothing to shrink.
storage.failed: {failed} files could not be read and were left as they are.
